BH-2626. Seconds a box's self-reported rules_reported_at (bin/box-self-report.sh, hourly) stays fresh enough to judge the box from its box_status row instead of ssh-ing it. Default 7200 = 2x the box-self-report lane's hourly period. 0 = self-reports ignored; every box is ssh'd, as before BH-2626. Non-numeric falls back to 7200. Read by bin/rules-drift-check.sh as ${RULES_DRIFT_SELF_REPORT_FRESH_S:-7200}.

BH-2626. Maximum age in seconds of a box's last full ssh probe before a box judged from its self-report row is ssh'd anyway, so RTK.md and settings.json, which the self-report row does not carry, are still checked. Default 86400 = a day; stamped per box under state/. 0 = every box is ssh'd every run, as before BH-2626. Non-numeric falls back to 86400. Read by bin/rules-drift-check.sh as ${RULES_DRIFT_FULL_PROBE_S:-86400}.
